description: List the label printers PrintHub has found for the organization: code, name, site, online or offline, and the printer language when PrintHub reports it. Use a printer's code with print_to_printer. Needs PrintHub installed on a computer the printer is connected to. Listing works on every plan; printing needs Professional or higher.

org.description: Organization: an id, a slug or ref:<your customer id>. Leave out to use your default organization.

site.description: Site slug, e.g. "oakland". Leave out for the whole organization.

state.description: activated (default): printers that have a code and can be printed to. discovered: found but not adopted yet. all: both.

name: list_printers
title: List Printers
